title: A Cancer Remembers Everything
topic: Cancer zodiac satire: a Cancer remembers everything
mechanism: Inside a Cancer head there is a crab shell with one tiny door marked SAFE PEOPLE ONLY, a FEELINGS cabinet whose overfull drawers never close, and a tissue box with a counter that already reads 41 by noon.

beats.hook: Rose at her own birthday table under a CANCER sign, smiling too hard: 'It's fine!'
beats.story: Rose cries at the TV insurance ad, her wall calendar is full of everyone's birthdays
beats.rise: Her warm kitchen: sad friends leave with soup and a hug, Amy calls her the best person alive
beats.twist: Amy opens the hallway closet; an avalanche of dated boxes buries her to the neck, one is her ninth-grade note
beats.mechanism: Crab shell with a tiny door SAFE PEOPLE ONLY; cabinet FEELINGS with drawers that won't close; tissue box counter at 41
beats.ending: The drawer of the friend who forgot slides open; Rose serves soup and a tear drops in

seed.what: The hallway closet door bulging, a box corner poking out, in Rose's home shot
